title: eevBLAB #76 - HUGE Youtube Ad Changes will impact YOU!
notes: The transcript contains extensive duplicated ASR text from paragraph 19 onward.

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: YouTube are making changes yet again

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: making some changes to mid-roll ads that will impact your channel

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: increase your monetization potential

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: only videos longer than 10 minutes are eligible for mid-roll ads

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: padded them out to like just greater than 10 minutes

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: all videos longer than 8 minutes will be eligible for mid-roll ads instead of 10 minutes

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: we will turn on mid-roll ads for all eligible videos

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: videos where you may have opted out of mid-roll ads will now be opted in

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: All I have is the skippable ads at the beginning of the video

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: after five seconds or whatever to skip the ad

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: you can double your revenue, your ad revenue

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: for all existing videos. It says all eligible videos

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: my entire back catalog

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: Turning on auto mid-roll ads saves creators extra work

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: We use machine learning to automatically find the most natural breaks in your video

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: while balancing user experience

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: in YouTube Studio by July 27

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: adjust the placement for each video manually

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: they're getting pressure from the advertisers

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: They're going to be turned on for all eligible existing videos and future videos

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: You'll get a five-second countdown timer that an ad's coming up

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: you'll see a little yellow marker so you can see how many ads are going to be inserted

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: how they went from zero mid-roll ads to like five mid-roll ads

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: Because there's two options, automatic or manual placement here

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: automatic or manual placement here

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: people are seeing like eight or ten ads in like a 30 minute video

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: eight or ten ads in like a 30 minute video

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: Imagine how many ads that YouTube would insert into my videos

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: automatically placed mid-roll ads are two times less interruptive than manually placed mid-roll ads
